name: Goblet squat
description: Hold a weight at your chest and squat down, keeping your torso upright.

name: Walking lunge
description: Step forward into a lunge, bring the back knee down, then step through.

name: Romanian deadlift
description: With soft knees, hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs, then stand tall.
caution: Hinge at the hips with a flat back. Stop if you feel pain in the lower back.

name: Leg press
description: Press the platform away with your feet, then lower with control without locking your knees.

name: Glute bridge
description: Lying on your back, lift your hips by squeezing your glutes, then lower.

name: Step-up
description: Step onto a box with one foot, drive through that heel, then step down slowly.

name: Seated leg curl
description: Curl the pad toward your seat by bending your knees, then return slowly.

name: Standing calf raise
description: Rise onto your toes and hold briefly, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Wall sit
description: Slide down a wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and hold.

name: Box jump
description: Jump from both feet onto a box, land softly, then step back down.
caution: Land softly with knees bent. Step down rather than jump down to protect the knees.

name: Chair squat
description: Lower your hips toward a chair, touch it lightly, and stand back up through your heels.

name: Standing hamstring curl
description: Hold a band around one ankle, curl your heel toward your glutes, and hold the back of a chair for balance.
